name: promptshield_screen
description: Screen untrusted text/HTML for prompt-injection before the model reads it. Paid x402 $0.002 USDC on Base. Returns risk, findings, sanitized. On high risk, prefer sanitized or abort.

arguments.name: content
arguments.desc: Untrusted text or HTML to screen

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: Content format: text or html (default text)

name: promptshield_clean
description: Convert HTML to clean LLM-ready text (strips scripts/styles/hidden/zero-width). Paid x402 $0.002 USDC on Base.

name: crawlsafe_check
description: Check whether a URL may be crawled for your user-agent (robots.txt + X-Robots-Tag/meta). SSRF-guarded. Not a malware scanner. Paid x402 $0.002 USDC on Base.

arguments.name: user_agent
arguments.desc: Crawler UA; first token matched against robots groups

arguments.name: check_page
arguments.desc: Also fetch up to 64KB for X-Robots-Tag/meta (default true)

name: toolguard_evaluate
description: Pre-tool-call policy gate for HTTP/MCP outbound actions. Returns allow|review|deny with deterministic reasons. Caller MUST enforce. Missing policy → review. Paid x402 $0.002 USDC on Base.

arguments.name: tool
arguments.desc: Tool name, e.g. http.fetch or mcp.call

name: commandguard_command
description: Check an agent-generated shell command BEFORE executing it. Returns allow|warn|block. Caller MUST enforce: do not run on block. Paid x402 $0.001 USDC on Base.

arguments.name: command
arguments.desc: Exact command line the agent intends to run

arguments.name: shell
arguments.desc: bash, sh, zsh, fish, powershell, or cmd

name: commandguard_sql
description: Check agent-generated SQL BEFORE executing it. Returns allow|warn|block. Caller MUST enforce. Paid x402 $0.001 USDC on Base.

arguments.name: dialect
arguments.desc: postgres, mysql, mariadb, sqlite, mssql, snowflake, bigquery, or other

name: memoryguard_screen
description: Screen content BEFORE writing it to an agent's long-term memory. Returns allow|review|block plus a sanitized copy. Paid x402 $0.002 USDC on Base.

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: user, assistant, tool, web, document, email, retrieved, mcp, or unknown

arguments.name: memory_type
arguments.desc: fact, preference, instruction, episodic, or summary

arguments.name: entries
arguments.desc: Batch of up to 25 memory entries

name: wireshield_scan
description: Scan agent OUTPUT before it is rendered or sent: image exfil, URL smuggling, canaries, prompt leakage, secrets. Returns allow|review|block plus a sanitized copy. Paid x402 $0.002 USDC on Base.

arguments.name: content
arguments.desc: Agent output about to be shown or sent

arguments.name: canaries
arguments.desc: Canary tokens planted in your system prompt

arguments.name: system_prompt
arguments.desc: Optional; used only for verbatim-overlap detection, never stored

name: docshield_scan
description: Scan a document BEFORE the agent reads it for hidden instructions in PDF/Office/HTML/Markdown. Max 3 MB. Paid x402 $0.004 USDC on Base.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Local file path (read by this MCP server on your machine)

name: grindfree_discovery
description: Return machine-readable discovery URLs and unpaid 402 challenge shapes for all GrindFree agent-security APIs (no payment).
